<description>
`IsWitnessStandard` rejects tapscript stack items over 80 bytes and an empty control block, and no test asserts `bad-witness-nonstandard` for either. With the 80-byte check removed, `feature_taproot.py` failed on only 6 of the ten seeds I tried, and with the empty control block check removed it can't fail at all, since none of its spenders has an empty control block. Without that check the node segfaults reading `control_block[0]`.

This adds a case for each to `mempool_accept.py`, by mutating the witness of the P2TR script-path spend the file already builds. Each case fails with its `policy.cpp` branch disabled and passes with it restored.
</description>
